chapterTitle: Annual Board Examination Section A Simulator 3 (FBISE Class 12 Chemistry)
title: Annual Board Examination Section A Simulator 3 (FBISE Class 12 Chemistry)
subject: chemistry-12

questions.question: The melting and boiling points of elements in Period 2 and Period 3 reach a maximum at:
questions.explanation: Group IVA elements (C in diamond, Si) form giant covalent network lattices with four strong covalent bonds per atom, demanding enormous energy to melt.

questions.question: When Lithium nitrate (LiNO₃) is heated strongly, it decomposes into:
questions.explanation: Unlike other alkali metal nitrates that yield nitrites and O₂, LiNO₃ decomposes like Group IIA nitrates into Li₂O, NO₂ (brown fumes), and O₂.

questions.question: In the Hall-Héroult industrial process for the extraction of aluminum, cryolite (Na₃AlF₆) is added to molten alumina (Al₂O₃) to:

options.A: Lower the melting point from 2050°C to ~950°C and improve electrical conductivity

questions.explanation: Cryolite dissolves Al₂O₃, depressing its melting point from over 2000°C to ~950°C and providing ionic conductivity.

questions.question: Which allotrope of sulfur is thermodynamically stable at room temperature (below 95.6°C)?
questions.explanation: Rhombic (α) sulfur consisting of puckered S₈ rings is the most stable allotrope below the transition temperature of 95.6°C.

questions.question: What is the molecular geometry of Chlorine trifluoride (ClF₃)?
questions.explanation: ClF₃ has 3 bond pairs and 2 lone pairs (sp³d). Lone pairs occupy equatorial sites, yielding a slightly bent T-shaped molecule.

questions.question: What is the geometry and coordination number of Iron in hemoglobin?
questions.explanation: Fe²⁺ is coordinated to 4 pyrrole nitrogens of the porphyrin ring, 1 histidine imidazole nitrogen, and 1 oxygen molecule (6 coordination positions, octahedral).

questions.question: Homolytic fission of a covalent C-C single bond generates:

options.B: Two neutral free radicals each carrying an unpaired electron
options.D: A carbocation and a hydride ion

questions.explanation: In homolytic cleavage (symmetrical breaking), each bonded atom retains one electron of the bonding pair: A:B → A• + B•.

questions.question: In the dehydration of alcohols to alkenes with concentrated sulfuric acid, what is the relative order of ease of dehydration?

options.D: All alcohols dehydrate at the same rate

questions.explanation: Dehydration proceeds via carbocation intermediates; tertiary alcohols form stable 3° carbocations easily at mild temperatures (~85°C with 20% H₂SO₄).

questions.question: When toluene (methylbenzene) is treated with chlorine in the presence of boiling temperature and bright sunlight (no catalyst), substitution occurs exclusively at:

options.A: The ortho position on the ring
options.B: The para position on the ring
options.C: The side-chain methyl group to form benzyl chloride (C₆H₅CH₂Cl)

questions.explanation: High temperature and light trigger free-radical halogenation of the side-chain: C₆H₅CH₃ + Cl₂ xrightarrow{hν, \Delta} C₆H₅CH₂Cl (benzyl chloride) + HCl.

questions.question: Which of the following compounds is known as Teflon and prepared by polymerization of tetrafluoroethene?
questions.explanation: Polytetrafluoroethene (PTFE / Teflon) consists of repeating -[CF₂-CF₂]- units with high chemical inertness and non-stick properties.

questions.question: What is the common chemical name of 1,2,3-propanetriol, a trihydric alcohol with sweet taste and high viscosity?
questions.explanation: Glycerol is CH₂OH-CHOH-CH₂OH, having 3 hydroxyl groups engaged in extensive hydrogen bonding, giving it high boiling point (290°C) and viscosity.

questions.question: Dry distillation of an equimolar mixture of calcium acetate and calcium formate yields:
What is the systematic IUPAC name for Adipic acid, a precursor for the manufacture of Nylon-6,6?
questions.explanation: Adipic acid has 6 carbons with terminal carboxyl groups: Hexanedioic acid.

questions.question: Which of the following polymers is an addition polymer synthesized from vinyl cyanide (acrylonitrile, CH₂=CH-CN)?
questions.explanation: Polyacrylonitrile (Orlon / Acrilan) is a wool-like synthetic fiber used in sweaters and blankets.

questions.question: The black liquor discharged from Kraft pulp digesters is concentrated and burned in a recovery furnace to:

options.A: Recover cooking chemicals (converting Na₂SO₄ to Na₂S and Na₂CO₃ to NaOH) and generate high-pressure steam for plant energy

questions.explanation: Burning black liquor recovers valuable inorganic chemicals and makes the pulp mill energetically self-sufficient by generating steam and power.

questions.question: Which greenhouse gas has the largest contribution to the human-induced greenhouse effect and global warming due to the vast volume emitted by fossil fuel combustion?
questions.explanation: While methane is more potent per molecule, CO₂ is responsible for >65% of global radiative forcing due to hundreds of billions of tons emitted globally.

questions.question: Bromination of benzene requires FeBr₃ or Fe as catalyst. The reaction between Fe and Br₂ forms FeBr₃, which functions as:

options.A: A halogen carrier that polarizes Br₂ into a Br⁺ electrophile and [FeBr₄]⁻

questions.explanation: Br₂ + FeBr₃ ⇌ Br⁺···FeBr₄⁻; the Lewis acid FeBr₃ polarizes the Br-Br bond to release the electrophilic bromonium ion.
